title: Run across a paired-input prefix
statement: Let $P$ be a register program with oracle, let $r$ be a register, and let $j_K,j_{K2},n_x$ be states. Suppose that at $j_K$ the transition scans the input and advances the head on register $r$ by one, moving to $j_K$ when the scanned bit is true and to $j_{K2}$ otherwise; at $j_{K2}$ it advances that register head by one and moves to $n_x$. Suppose neither $j_K$ nor $j_{K2}$ is an oracle-call state. If the input is $1^{2n}01$ followed by a word $\mathrm{rest}$, then the run from the configuration with the tapes and output of $c$, state $j_K$, input-head position $1$, and register-head position $p$ reaches the configuration with the same tapes and output, state $n_x$, input-head position $3+2n$, and register-head position $p$; before that endpoint, each run state has the form specified by the reachability relation, with no oracle call.
hypotheses_covered: Transition at $j_K$ has the specified scan-dependent behavior
Transition at $j_{K2}$ has the specified behavior
Neither $j_K$ nor $j_{K2}$ is a call state
